mechanism: Option 2 (docker exec with branch code at a container temp path). Host python3.11 on empressa-bot has no sqlalchemy/psycopg/pydantic_settings, so Option 1 (a /tmp clone run with host python) would have required installing packages and risked version drift from production. The cockpit-api container already carries the exact production deps (python 3.12.13, sqlalchemy 2.0.36), has /var/lib/cockpit bind-mounted at the same path so the on-host SEC cache is readable unchanged, carries COCKPIT_DATABASE_URL in its process env, and has proven reachability to the empressa-cloud-sql-proxy sidecar. Procedure: git archive of PR #331 head 10869018 (apps/cockpit/backend) built locally, scp to the VM, extracted to /tmp/tw31 on the host, docker cp to /tmp/tw31 INSIDE the container, line endings normalised to LF, then run as: docker exec -w /tmp/tw31 empressa-cockpit-api timeout 900 nice -n 19 python scripts/rebuild_issuer_links.py --all --json-out ... --sample-limit 40. The container image was NOT modified, the container was NOT restarted (RestartCount=0, StartedAt=2026-08-13T16:19:49Z, identical before and after), no deploy, no migration, and the deployed tree under /opt/empressa was never written (mtimes still 2026-06-29). All temp paths removed afterwards on both host and container. NOTE: the dispatch asked for '--all --dry-run'; there is no --dry-run flag on this CLI. Dry run is the DEFAULT and a write requires BOTH --apply and --yes-write, so the run was --all alone and neither write flag was ever passed. Staged code verified byte-identical to PR head: LF-normalised sha256 of cik_crosswalk.py, issuer_rebuild.py, rebuild_issuer_links.py, edgar.py, resolver.py and models.py all match the git blobs at 10869018.
